biggestRisk: The plan makes the grown-ups' GameChange settings per family and loads them for whichever child signs in, but applyOnce lays them over the rule tables once per page load, before anyone signs in. A child who signs in or switches after boot plays on the wrong family's tables, and a save that uses another family's custom step makes the engine throw. Server saves are also never routed through mend(). So the boundary between sign-in and settings needs a reload-based redesign that the plan does not contain (the stranger names this itself in Q12).
